ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Crochet uses your location to provide localized pattern recommendations and yarn store suggestions.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Crochet uses your photo library so you can import and save project inspiration, progress photos, and pattern images.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Crochet saves exported pattern images and project snapshots to your photo library.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Crochet uses your camera so you can identify stitches from a photo.
